// diagnostic

E1121

A case number of a `#Layout({backing})` enum is outside the range of `{backing}`.

What

A case number of a `#Layout({backing})` enum is outside the range of `{backing}`.

Why

`#Layout({backing})` stores every case number as a `{backing}`; a case without a number is one more than the case before it.

Fix

Use a number the backing type holds, or a wider backing type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1121: tests/ui/enum_backing_refusals.stderr.

Error [jet.PayloadCaseWithIntBacking]: `#Layout(U8)` backs only a payload-free enum, and case `Circle` of `Shape` carries a payload
  --> tests/ui/enum_backing_refusals.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | #Layout(U8)
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A backing type gives each case one number; a case with fields is more than a number
 Fix: Remove the payload from `Circle`, or remove `#Layout(U8)` and convert with your own methods
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1120

Error [jet.CaseNumberOutOfRange]: Case `Large` is 256, which `U8` can't hold
  --> tests/ui/enum_backing_refusals.jet:10:13
    |
 10 |     Large = 256
    |             ^^^
 Why: `#Layout(U8)` stores every case number of `Wide` as a `U8` (0 to 255)
 Fix: Use a number from 0 to 255, or a wider backing type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1121

Error [jet.CaseNumberOutOfRange]: Case `Over` counts up to 128, which `I8` can't hold
  --> tests/ui/enum_backing_refusals.jet:16:5
    |
 16 |     Over
    |     ^^^^
 Why: A case without a number is one more than the case before it, and `#Layout(I8)` stores numbers from -128 to 127
 Fix: Give `Over` a number from -128 to 127, or use a wider backing type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1121

Error [jet.DuplicateCaseNumber]: Cases `First` and `Third` of `Twice` are both 3
  --> tests/ui/enum_backing_refusals.jet:23:5
    |
 23 |     Third
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `Twice.from_int(3)` has to name one case
 Fix: Give `Third` a number no other case uses
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1122

Error [jet.InvalidEnumDiscriminant]: Case `Base` of `Computed` needs a literal number
  --> tests/ui/enum_backing_refusals.jet:30:12
    |
 30 |     Base = LIMIT
    |            ^^^^^
 Why: `#Layout(U8)` case numbers are checked against `U8` and against each other where the enum is declared
 Fix: Write the number as an integer literal, such as `Base = 0`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0035
